description: This header file defines the interface for the Wraps class and its implementation, providing virtual methods to wrap system calls and other system functions, primarily for mocking and testing purposes.

classes.name: WrapsImpl
classes.description: Abstract class providing virtual system call wrappers for mocking, including methods like system, popen, pclose, syslog, setmntent, getmntent, v_secure_popen, v_secure_pclose, v_secure_system, readlink, and time.

methods.name: system
methods.description: Virtual method to execute a system command.

methods.name: popen
methods.description: Virtual method to open a process by creating a pipe, for executing commands.

methods.name: pclose
methods.description: Virtual method to close a pipe opened by popen.

methods.name: syslog
methods.description: Virtual method to log system messages.

methods.name: setmntent
methods.description: Virtual method to open the mount table file.

methods.name: getmntent
methods.description: Virtual method to read a filesystem mount entry.

methods.name: v_secure_popen
methods.description: Virtual method for a secure version of popen, accepting va_list args.

methods.name: v_secure_pclose
methods.description: Virtual method for closing a pipe from v_secure_popen.

methods.name: v_secure_system
methods.description: Virtual method to execute a system command with va_list args.

methods.name: readlink
methods.description: Virtual method to read the value of a symbolic link.

methods.name: time
methods.description: Virtual method to get the current time.
